clips.title: A combined-arms fight, full size
clips.note: One machine, one pass, no cuts and no camera written for this page — the game’s own chase camera over the city it generated, with everything in the frame doing what it does: armour manoeuvring, air defence tracking, a hundred-tonne machine walking into it, and the buildings coming down when something hits them.

clips.title: Guns and missiles at sea
clips.note: A displacement hull with a rudder that only bites while water is flowing past it, a gun house that trains independently of the bow, and an enemy line doing the same thing back. The sea state, the wake and the shell splashes are the same renderer that draws the land.

clips.title: Fighters, and a wing that can stall
clips.note: A 3-DOF point-mass wing: bank splits the lift vector so you pull in the turn, a V-n limit means a slow aeroplane cannot pull the g a fast one can, and the missiles bleed energy in a hard turn exactly as yours do. The hostiles hold a cruise altitude and climb at rates their airframe allows.

clips.title: A strike, and the hole it leaves
clips.note: Ordnance going into a defended position: every detonation carves a real crater into the heightmap rather than painting a scorch on it, the rim slumps so a vehicle can still climb out, and whatever was standing over the hole comes down with it. The air defence is shooting back the whole way in.

clips.title: The death replay, uncut
clips.note: Not a camera script written for this page — this is the game’s own director, filmed end to end at the speed you see it. Your machine comes apart on your own camera; it holds on what killed you and says what and from how far; it winds the last five seconds back and plays them forward, standing off the line the round is travelling down so you and the thing that killed you are both in frame while it arrives; then it cuts between shots that each carry a move.

clips.title: A hundred tonnes, walking
clips.note: A two-segment leg with a real knee, a stride whose length is what actually carries the machine forward, and a waist that lets the torso train while the legs keep walking. It is a machine, not a tall tank: it wades rather than swims, it loses the limb you shot, and a heavy round staggers it.

clips.title: Armour on the deck
clips.note: A land vehicle rides on springs over four wheel stations, and its track bridges a hollow rather than dropping into it. The hull steers while the turret trains independently, and every round leaves on the boresight, so the crosshair is honest at any range without a lock.

cards.name: KA-52 ALLIGATOR
cards.desc: Coaxial attack heli — no tail rotor, brutally agile. Full arsenal.

cards.name: RAH-66 COMANCHE
cards.desc: Stealth interceptor. Railgun, ARC-LASER beam, tesla arc and a radar AAM.

cards.name: AH-64 APACHE
cards.desc: The all-rounder. Cannon, rockets, missiles and bombs.

cards.name: MI-28 HAVOC
cards.desc: Heavily-armoured Russian gunship — broad + tough, full attack arsenal. Eats a few rockets.

cards.name: MI-24 HIND
cards.desc: Heavy gunship. Slow and ponderous but armored, full arsenal.

cards.name: OH-58D KIOWA WARRIOR
cards.desc: Armed scout — mast sight sees over cover. Light rockets and Hellfire. Very fragile.

cards.name: MH-6 LITTLE BIRD
cards.desc: Tiny special-ops scout — blisteringly nimble and fast, but eggshell armour.

cards.name: V-22 OSPREY
cards.desc: Tiltrotor assault transport — fast cruise, vertical lift. Tough; door guns + rockets.

cards.name: COAXIAL ROTOR DRONE
cards.desc: Unmanned coaxial — tiny, quiet, cheap. Two guided munitions and nothing to spare.

cards.name: AH-6 LITTLE BIRD
cards.desc: Fast, nimble, fragile. Minigun and rocket pods.

cards.name: SH-60 SEAHAWK
cards.desc: Naval helicopter — ASW torpedoes and a door gun. At home over the sea, folds on deck.

cards.name: SKYCRANE
cards.desc: A rotor, a spine and a hook — no cabin at all. Lifts anything, hides from nothing.

cards.name: CH-47 CHINOOK
cards.desc: Tandem-rotor heavy lift. Tough and steady; twin door guns, rockets, bombs.

cards.name: AH-1Z VIPER
cards.desc: Slim dedicated attack helicopter — fast + agile, lightly armoured. Cannon + missiles.

cards.name: AC-130 GUNSHIP
cards.desc: Orbiting gunship — a 105mm and a 40mm firing out of the left flank. Slow, huge, deadly.

cards.name: E-3 SENTRY AWACS
cards.desc: Airborne early warning — an enormous radar and nothing to shoot with. See everything.

cards.name: B-52 STRATOFORTRESS
cards.desc: Strategic bomber. Slow and huge; a devastating bomb load.

cards.name: DEV TESTBED (all weapons)
cards.desc: Development airframe: every weapon in the game, tough hull, long radar. For testing.

cards.name: F/A-18 HORNET
cards.desc: Twin-engined carrier strike fighter. Cannon, rockets, missiles.

cards.name: SU-57 FELON
cards.desc: Agile twin-engine stealth multirole — the Raptor's rival. Heavy missile loadout.

cards.name: JAS-39 GRIPEN
cards.desc: Light delta-canard fighter. Turns hardest; thin-skinned. BVR + SEAD.

cards.name: AC-130 SPECTRE
cards.desc: Gunship. Orbits low and slow, raining heavy gunfire and ordnance.

cards.name: AV-8B HARRIER II
cards.desc: Agile multirole jump-jet — cannon, rockets, AA + anti-ship missiles.

cards.name: STRATEGIC AIRLIFTER
cards.desc: Fat, high-winged and T-tailed. Carries everything, fights nothing. Very tough.

cards.name: F-35 LIGHTNING
cards.desc: Stealth multirole. Plasma, homing missiles and bombs.

cards.name: F-22 RAPTOR
cards.desc: Stealth superiority fighter. ARC-LASER beam, gauss slug, AAMs.

cards.name: FLYING BOAT
cards.desc: A hull that flies — slow, roomy, and the only aircraft built to meet the water.

cards.name: B-2 SPIRIT
cards.desc: Stealth flying-wing bomber — a wide dark delta; massive payload, slow to turn.

cards.name: VARIABLE-GEOMETRY STRIKE
cards.desc: Swing wing — spread to loiter and turn, swept to run. Heavy centreline load.

cards.name: REFUELLING TANKER
cards.desc: A flying fuel state with a boom down its tail. Unarmed but for a defensive gun.

cards.name: A-29 SUPER TUCANO
cards.desc: Light attack turboprop — slow enough to see the target, cheap enough to lose. Loiters.

cards.name: UCAV STRIKE DRONE
cards.desc: Unmanned tailless delta — small, quiet, expendable. Guided munitions from a bay.

cards.name: A-10 WARTHOG
cards.desc: Ground-attack jet. Heavy cannon, rockets and bombs; tough.

cards.name: M1A2 ABRAMS
cards.desc: Main battle tank. A 120mm smoothbore -- APFSDS or HEAT-MP -- and a .50 cal. Heavily armoured.

cards.name: AAV-7 AMTRAC
cards.desc: Amphibious assault APC — drives the beach AND swims. Gatling + rockets.

cards.name: FH77 BW L52
cards.desc: Swedish wheeled 155mm L52. Fires, then drives off before the answer lands. Thin skin.

cards.name: M2 BRADLEY IFV
cards.desc: Tracked infantry fighting vehicle — 25mm chain gun + TOW missiles. Tough.

cards.name: M1150 BREACHER
cards.desc: Assault breacher. Mine plough, line charges, demolition gun. Goes first.

cards.name: RECON BUGGY
cards.desc: Fast light scout. Pintle minigun and rockets; nimble but fragile.

cards.name: B1 CENTAURO
cards.desc: 8x8 wheeled tank destroyer. A 120mm tank gun at truck speed, on a thin skin.

cards.name: GEPARD FLAKPANZER
cards.desc: Radar-guided AA tank — twin 35mm autocannons shred aircraft. Armoured; eats rockets.

cards.name: BM-21 GRAD
cards.desc: Rocket artillery — forty tubes, one trigger. Saturates an area, then runs. Thin skin.

cards.name: M142 HIMARS
cards.desc: Fast wheeled rocket artillery — salvo rockets, hit-and-run. Light armour.

cards.name: HMMWV TECHNICAL
cards.desc: Fast light 4x4. Pintle minigun and rocket pods. Nimble, fragile.

cards.name: LEOPARD 2A7
cards.desc: German main battle tank. A long 120mm L55 -- APFSDS or HEAT-MP. Quicker than the Abrams, lighter.

cards.name: SAM CARRIER
cards.desc: Mobile launcher. Homing AA + heavy missiles; lobs them on the move.

cards.name: 2S19 MSTA-S
cards.desc: Heavy self-propelled howitzer — a 152mm that reaches over the hill. Slow, well armoured.

cards.name: M109A7 PALADIN
cards.desc: Self-propelled 155mm howitzer. Lays itself on the target -- HE, Excalibur GPS, SMArt top-attack.

cards.name: PZH 2000
cards.desc: German 155mm L52 self-propelled howitzer. Longest reach in the fleet; four rounds that land at once.

cards.name: ZSU-23-4 SHILKA
cards.desc: Quad 23mm SPAAG — a wall of tracer at short range. Light, slow, murderous up close.

cards.name: BM-30 SMERCH
cards.desc: Heavy MRL — six 300mm rockets that level what they land on. Ponderous, fragile.

cards.name: M1126 STRYKER
cards.desc: 8x8 wheeled IFV. Armoured and quick; slat armour, remote gun.

cards.name: 2S6 TUNGUSKA
cards.desc: Gun and missile air defence — twin 30mm plus short-range SAMs. Owns the low sky.

cards.name: ARSENAL SHIP
cards.desc: A hull that is one enormous magazine — 36 launch cells and almost no gun. Kill it first.

cards.name: BATTLESHIP
cards.desc: Big-gun dreadnought. Heavy artillery + missiles; immense but can pivot on the spot.

cards.name: AIRCRAFT CARRIER
cards.desc: Supercarrier — a mobile airbase. Immense and slow, but can turn on the spot.

cards.name: MISSILE CORVETTE
cards.desc: Fast light missile boat — ship-killer + AA missiles. Quick and agile, lighter armour than a frigate.

cards.name: MISSILE CRUISER
cards.desc: Ticonderoga AEGIS cruiser — long-reach SPY radar + a huge VLS arsenal (cruise + ballistic land-attack). The fleet's missile/sensor flagship: slower and lighter-hulled than a destroyer, but out-ranges and out-shoots it.

cards.name: STEALTH DESTROYER
cards.desc: Angular stealth destroyer — VLS land-attack + AA, a deck gun + CIWS. Fast for its size.

cards.name: GUIDED-MISSILE FRIGATE
cards.desc: Fast escort warship. Deck gun, AA and ship-killer missiles. Water only.

cards.name: LCAC HOVERCRAFT
cards.desc: Air-cushion landing craft — skims water AND land. Gatling + rockets.

cards.name: HYDROFOIL GUNBOAT
cards.desc: Rides on foils clear of the water — the fastest hull afloat. A rapid gun, nothing more.

cards.name: AMPHIBIOUS LANDING SHIP
cards.desc: A floating garage with a bow ramp. Slow, tough, barely armed — it delivers, not fights.

cards.name: FAST ATTACK CRAFT
cards.desc: Missile boat — four anti-ship canisters and enormous speed. One hit and it is gone.

cards.name: PT GUNBOAT
cards.desc: Fast attack boat. Minigun, rockets and a deck cannon. Water only.

cards.name: ATTACK SUBMARINE
cards.desc: Nuclear attack sub — runs at periscope depth (sail + scope show) and can DIVE (F) to hide, then SURFACE to fire. VLS missiles BREACH the water and climb like sub-launched rounds. Torpedoes, anti-ship + land-attack + ballistic missiles.

cards.name: ANVIL
cards.desc: The brawler — a particle cannon on each arm and missile pods over both shoulders. Symmetrical and unsubtle.

cards.name: BARRAGE
cards.desc: Fire-support mech — two HAIL boxes over the shoulders. Shoots from behind the ridge and walks away.

cards.name: BASTION
cards.desc: A medium with a beaked sensor head, a rotary cannon and a grappling claw with a MAUL in it. Quick for its weight.

cards.name: BULWARK
cards.desc: Hundred-ton assault mech. A MAUL in one fist, QUILL racks on the arms and HAIL boxes over the shoulders. Nothing stops it; nothing hurries it.

cards.name: CAISSON
cards.desc: Armless: two vast missile pods where the arms should be. A launcher on legs, and nothing else.

cards.name: GANTRY
cards.desc: Low, hunched and forward-leaning on bird legs, with particle cannons slung under both arms. All shoulders and stride.

cards.name: MONOLITH
cards.desc: No head. A sensor strip set into the chest, four launch blocks and nothing to look at you with.

cards.name: OUTRIDER
cards.desc: The fast one — shoulder railgun and pulse lasers. Outruns what it cannot out-armour.

cards.name: PICKET
cards.desc: Built to clear ground — a flamer on one arm, a rotary cannon on the other, and legs that get there first. QUILL racks over the shoulders for what the flamer cannot touch.

cards.name: RAMPART
cards.desc: The tallest thing that walks, and the only one with a comms mast. Sees the fight before the fight sees it.

cards.name: REDOUBT
cards.desc: A squat armoured drum on stubby bird legs carrying a cannon far too big for it. Funny right up until it fires.

cards.name: SLEDGE
cards.desc: Squat, enormously wide, and carrying a gauss cannon bigger than its own torso. Do not stand in front of it.

cards.name: SPIRE
cards.desc: A knight. A tower shield on one arm and a molten sword on the other. It walks slowly because nothing it meets survives the wait.

cards.name: TRESTLE
cards.desc: Four-legged gun platform. Twin siege cannon, stable enough to fire everything at once.

work.subject: trailer: re-filming what the cut uses takes ~10 min (was ~100 for everything) -- --cut-only, --jobs=N worker processes, the game's model/sound disk caches turned on (session build 26 s -> 6-14 s), NVENC, the readback straight to the encoder and double-buffered so it never waits on the GPU (one take 79 s -> 38 s, frames identical); per-stage timings in the log; log, lesson (936), board

the canyon's cliffs: the hit is bisected to the side in the ground (the midpoint could be air in front of a wall, over the sea -- a checkerboard of rock and sea), a wall wears its own top cell's colour, and only a building's marked roof gets windows (config.bld_roof) -- every other crisp face is rock; two new GPU self-test parts, witnessed three ways; no measurable GPU cost

trailer: every angle records the game version it was filmed on ('older game' in --list, and the cut names its clips from older code); all 187 angles re-filmed on the current game and the trailer re-cut; log, lesson (934), board (and the TTS fallback's write-up)

tts: the box went quiet on its WireGuard address (10.8.0.9) while it still answered on the LAN, so every render failed on a timeout -- tts_tool now tries fallback_urls (192.168.1.3 by default) and says which it used; --list no longer crashes on a Windows console; the 8 voice lines that were missing rendered (iron gauntlet, deck recovery, recovered)
